lead: Recent developments in health technology raise questions about the accuracy of AI-driven health tools, the governance of AI in healthcare, and the evolving landscape of health-related consumer products.

stories.title: A lawsuit says Oura’s sleep stages are AI guesses with a coin flip’s odds
stories.summary: A proposed class action lawsuit claims that Oura's sleep tracking technology relies on AI estimates rather than accurate measurements, suggesting its accuracy is akin to a coin flip. Oura Health Oy, the Finnish parent company, defends its technology, asserting the reliability of its claims. This case highlights growing scrutiny over the validity of consumer health tech.

stories.title: The Single English County Saying No to Palantir
stories.summary: Greater Manchester is pushing back against a significant healthcare contract with Palantir, arguing that local authorities can manage healthcare data more effectively. This decision reflects a broader debate about the role of private companies in public health and the need for local governance in healthcare data management.

stories.title: Frustrated GP patients hang up as Yorkshire accent baffles AI receptionist
stories.summary: Patients in Rotherham are facing challenges with an AI receptionist named Emma, which struggles to understand local accents. The situation raises concerns about the effectiveness of AI in healthcare settings, particularly regarding accessibility and patient experience. Healthwatch Rotherham has highlighted the need for technology that meets the linguistic diversity of patients.

stories.title: Wesfarmers Health moving up to SAP S/4HANA
stories.summary: Wesfarmers Health is transitioning to SAP S/4HANA as part of its multi-year technology roadmap, aiming to enhance its operational efficiency and data management capabilities. This move reflects a trend among healthcare organizations to modernize their IT infrastructure to better support patient care and operational needs.

stories.title: All the Health and Fitness Products You Didn't Realize You Could Buy With HSA Funds
stories.summary: Consumers are often unaware of the range of health and fitness products eligible for purchase with Health Savings Account (HSA) funds. This article explores creative ways to utilize pre-tax health dollars, emphasizing the importance of financial literacy in managing health-related expenses effectively.

stories.title: Explainable AI is necessary, but it’s not enough
stories.summary: The article discusses the limitations of explainable AI in healthcare, emphasizing that while understanding AI decision-making is crucial, it is not sufficient for ensuring accurate outcomes. It advocates for a comprehensive governance framework that includes knowledge and policy oversight to prevent errors in AI-driven decisions.

stories.title: Compassion is not a control: What veterinary practices reveal about AI governance
stories.summary: The integration of AI in veterinary practices raises questions about accountability and governance. While AI can enhance efficiency, it is crucial for practices to establish clear guidelines on its use to prevent reliance on flawed tools. The article stresses the need for oversight in AI applications to maintain trust and accuracy in patient care.

stories.title: Social media on trial as $200bn case against Facebook and Instagram begins
stories.summary: A landmark trial involving Meta's platforms, Facebook and Instagram, is underway, with 29 US states alleging that these platforms are designed to be addictive. This case echoes historical legal actions against industries contributing to public health crises, highlighting the ongoing debate about the impact of social media on mental health.
